# Frozen selection (generated by `npm run multi-etf-d1 -- freeze`)

Manifest: `FROZEN_CANDIDATES.json`, SHA-256 of its body **`d3645e1e8b8dafbdbf5ca6b7ef3b78745a3389b7730b19f68df0647377f4ca7e`**, frozen at 2026-10-23T13:22:39.335Z (UTC) at git HEAD `2693818d7a1c8edeaa9962466ff2c3d998a5a10d` with uncommitted changes in .gitignore, package.json, src/d1-refinement/engine.ts, src/d1-refinement/evaluate.ts. Protocol hash `8aca95c39744c110382f6b4dd7d52ec6353304c9e5a1c67781041ae097c91627`. Engine `d1-refinement-engine-v1`.

Every figure below is a development-window figure (2017-06-15 → 2023-12-29, $100,000 per entry, 11%, stop fills). No 2024–2025 figure existed when this file was written. The holdout command verifies this manifest's hash, the data hashes and the decision-code hashes before it runs, and the final report repeats the hash so the two can be compared.

## Basis for selection (PROTOCOL.md section 7)

- Feasible: minute-sampled DD ≤ $35,000 and at least ⌈0.75 × training years⌉ entries on the window judged.
- Beats D1: training net above frozen D1's on the same ticker and window.
- Plateau: ≥ 75% of the one-parameter probes feasible and the median probe net ≥ 70% of the candidate's.
- Primary: highest net among plateau candidates, preferring DD ≤ $25,000; alternates: a higher-net distinct phenotype (maxNet) and a lower-DD distinct phenotype keeping ≥ 75% of the primary's net (lowDd).
- Sparse: fewer than 10 closed development trades = insufficient evidence (flagged, not re-selected).
